events.title: William Caxton prints his English translation of Aesop's Fables
events.description: England's first printer completed his edition of the 'Fables of Esope' at Westminster, illustrated with woodcuts. Caxton's books helped standardise written English.
events.html: England's first printer completed his edition of the 'Fables of Esope' at Westminster, illustrated with woodcuts. Caxton's books helped standardise written English.

events.title: Earthquake devastates Caracas and Venezuela
events.description: On Holy Thursday a powerful earthquake destroyed Caracas and other towns held by the young republic, killing thousands. Royalist clergy called it divine punishment, and the First Republic soon fell.
events.html: On Holy Thursday a powerful earthquake destroyed Caracas and other towns held by the young republic, killing thousands. Royalist clergy called it divine punishment, and the First Republic soon fell.

events.title: Ludwig van Beethoven dies in Vienna
events.description: Beethoven died aged 56 during a thunderstorm. Despite growing deafness he composed nine symphonies and late string quartets that changed Western music, and some 20,000 people attended his funeral.
events.html: Beethoven died aged 56 during a thunderstorm. Despite growing deafness he composed nine symphonies and late string quartets that changed Western music, and some 20,000 people attended his funeral.

events.title: Bangladesh declares independence from Pakistan
events.description: After the Pakistani army's crackdown in Dhaka, independence was proclaimed in the name of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. Nine months of war followed, and Bangladesh won its freedom in December 1971.
events.html: After the Pakistani army's crackdown in Dhaka, independence was proclaimed in the name of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. Nine months of war followed, and Bangladesh won its freedom in December 1971.

events.title: Egypt and Israel sign a peace treaty
events.description: At the White House, Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin signed the first peace treaty between Israel and an Arab state, building on the Camp David Accords. Israel returned the Sinai by 1982.
events.html: At the White House, Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin signed the first peace treaty between Israel and an Arab state, building on the Camp David Accords. Israel returned the Sinai by 1982.

events.title: Schengen Agreement abolishes border checks in Europe
events.description: Seven European countries, including France and Germany, removed passport controls at their common borders. The Schengen Area now covers most of the European Union and several other states.
